name: Thunder Subtitle
description: Scheduled task that finds movies in the selected libraries that have no subtitles at all, extracts the JAV code from the file name (ABF-363-U.strm -> ABF-363), queries the Xunlei subtitle API, downloads every candidate, drops machine-translated ones, picks the largest remaining file and writes it next to the .strm as <name>.chi.srt/.ass so Jellyfin picks it up as an external subtitle. A second task re-picks better subtitles for files this plugin wrote earlier.
overview: 为 JAV 影片从迅雷字幕 API 自动下载高质量外挂字幕。

versions.changelog:
Release 1.3.0.0

超时改为按请求设置：搜索 20 秒、单条下载 15 秒，不再用全局 60 秒；候选改为并发下载（默认 4 路），并给每部影片加 90 秒总预算，到点用手上已有的候选排序。修复一部慢速 CDN 的影片能把整个任务卡住十几分钟的问题。
